newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-JUVE'S BETTEGA SAYS ALL PLAYERS HAVE PRICE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVE'S BETTEGA SAYS ALL PLAYERS HAVE PRICE.

text.p: Juventus vice-president Roberto Bettega, asked about reports of an offer for attacker Christian Vieri by Atletico Madrid of Spain, suggested on Wednesday that every player had his price.
"For us they are all transferable and not transferable," Bettega said enigmatically,
"When we get an offer for a player of ours we always evaluate it, independently of the decision that will be taken successively."
The Turin daily Tuttosport reported on Wednesday that Atletico had offered 25 billion lire ($15 million) for Italian international striker Vieri.
It said Yugoslav Kunovad Resad, assistant to Atletico's coach Radomir Antic, had let the news slip at a dinner with friends in Madrid.
Tuttosport said Atletico director general Miguel Angel Gil, son of president Jesus Gil, had contacted Juventus through an Italian intermediary.
Vieri told reporters he was thinking only of helping Juventus win the Italian league and retain the European Cup.
